items.label: POST_HOC
items.what: H3 nested test: do the lag weights differ from constant weights? Reduced (constant weights) = outcome ~ W56 cumulative exposure + M2-L, exactly the archived CUM ... W56 ... M2_L model (rain: the archived rainy-day count; the test is invariant to dividing by 56). Full (varying weights) = the existing final L01-L56 DLM (linear exposure x natural cubic spline over lag, 3 df, internal knot 28.5, boundary knots 1 and 56, lag basis with intercept). The reduced model is the full model with a flat lag curve: 2 df.
items.pairs: the nine representative pairs: 3 outcomes x (UTCI, IMS RH, rainy-day indicator), same 55 participants and the same M2-L covariates in both models

nesting_checks.column_space: the reduced design lies in the column space of the full design (rank of the joint matrix equals the full rank; residual of the reduced exposure column on the full design <= 1e-8 relative)
nesting_checks.constrained_fit: constraining the two non-constant lag directions to zero (lag coefficients proportional to the vector a with B a = 1) reproduces the reduced fit (fitted values, RSS / deviance; relative 1e-8)
nesting_checks.on_failure: STOP: the nesting status is FAIL and no test is reported

tests.continuous: nested model-based F test with 2 and n - p_full (45) df; plus an HC3 Wald test of the 2 extra coefficients (Wald W = (C b)'(C V_HC3 C')^-1 (C b) with C spanning the complement of a; p from F(2, n - p_full) applied to W/2, the lm convention)
tests.binary: likelihood-ratio test with 2 df from the two ML deviances (both fits with the final DLM glm control, epsilon 1e-12, maxit 200)

multiplicity.rule: BH across the nine model-based p values; distinct from the existing global q9

items.run_record: H3_RUN_RECORD.json: protocol declaration (name, version, status line, SHA-256), timestamp, input SHA-256, run id, source fingerprint, nesting checks

reduced_coefficients.rule: the reduced W56 M2-L exposure coefficient (archived cumulative glm control) equals the archived CUM W56 M2_L coefficient (tolerance class cumulative)

full_global_p.rule: the full model global p equals the archived global p (tolerance class dlm)
full_global_p.table3_rule: rounded to 3 decimals; the order assumed is outcome (configuration order) x representative metric (configuration order), the order of the final DLM output

acceptance.finite: no non-finite value in the nine rows

stored_precision.rule: for TD, RH and rainfall: every analysed participant-day present, the same missing-value pattern, and max |difference| <= 1e-8 (one unit in the 8th decimal) (as amended by amendment_v2_3; the 8-decimal rounding-equality counts are reported as informational columns)

items.assigned_stations: rows of the spatial audit with METHOD = IDW and PLAN_INCLUDED = 1 for the analysed participants; VARIABLE TD (also used for RH) and rainfall; three stations per participant and variable

rules.coverage_rule: per participant-day and assigned station: non-missing values (TD_C for TD, RH_PCT for RH, RAIN_MM for rainfall) in the raw 10-minute files for that station and JERUSALEM_LOCAL_DATE / expected intervals (144 per local day, 138 on the 23-hour DST day 2026-03-27; rainfall of the five 1-minute stations 1,440, or 1,380 on 2026-03-27); a station covers the day if the fraction is >= 0.80

items.station_pool_rule: coordinate-valid stations = details.coordinate_valid_stations of the stage A coordinate metadata; requested = details.download_station_ids of stage A (cross-checked with the number of stations in the stage B fetch_status); returned = details.completed_stations of stage B; eligible = stations with period coverage >= 80 % per variable, and AVAILABLE_STATIONS of the plan file. The period-coverage-file counts of requested / returned stations are kept as record-only rows. A station file with any participant-level field stops the step
items.tolerance: counts exact; km to 0.1 (1 decimal); percentages to 0.1; rows marked record only are shown but do not count in EXPOSURE_QA_SI_CONCORDANCE_STATUS
items.statuses: INPUT_PROVENANCE_STATUS (every declared file identified by SHA-256 and size); EXPOSURE_SOURCE_IDENTITY_STORED_PRECISION_STATUS (required; governs the identity requirement); EXPOSURE_SOURCE_IDENTITY_STRICT_1E9 reported in POSTHOC_STATUS.txt as informational (kept for the record); EXPOSURE_QA_COMPUTATION_STATUS (three assigned stations per participant and variable; every participant-day present); EXPOSURE_QA_SI_CONCORDANCE_STATUS (PASS if every derivable expected value agrees, otherwise REVIEW with the differences)
